LESSON: PLANE GEOMETRY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.1: Plane Geometry

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Plane Geometry. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify instruments used in drawing
2. explain the layout of a drawing environment
3. construct combined shapes applied in drawing

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: PLANE GEOMETRY
Plane Geometry is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Plane Geometry problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Plane Geometry question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Plane Geometry question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Plane Geometry set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Plane Geometry.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Plane Geometry in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify instruments used in drawing
2. explain the layout of a drawing environment
3. construct combined shapes applied in drawing

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
